about: Animated court diagrams for the practice plans. Coordinates are in feet on one side of the court: x runs 0–30 from the left sideline to the right, y runs 0 at the net to 30 at the end line; negative y is the other side of the net. Each step moves only the actors it lists. 'ballFrom' starts the ball's flight from a fixed point.

rotation.title: Rotation
rotation.summary: Six players move one spot clockwise when their team wins the serve back, and the player in spot 1 serves.

steps.say: Six spots. Front row at the net: 4, 3 and 2. Back row: 5, 6 and 1.
The player in spot 1, right back, serves from behind the end line.
Side-out: the team wins the serve back.
Everyone moves one spot clockwise.
The player now in spot 1 serves. Know where you are. Know who serves next.

pass-to-target.title: Passing to a target
pass-to-target.summary: The coach tosses from across the net and the player passes to a hoop at the setter's spot.

steps.say: A hula hoop or cone marks the setter's spot, right front.
The coach tosses from the other side of the net. She faces the ball: belly button to the ball.
She passes with her platform to the target.
As players improve, the tosses get longer and wider.
Thumbs down, elbows locked, platform to the target.

serve-receive-line.title: Serve receive: three across the back row
serve-receive-line.summary: Three players line up across the back row; the player closest to the serve calls mine and passes to the target while the others move away.

steps.say: Three players in a line across the back row, in ready position.
The coach serves (or tosses) from the other side.
The player closest to the ball calls “mine.” The others move out of the way.
She passes to the target.

pass-set-hit.title: Pass, set, hit
pass-set-hit.summary: The passer calls mine and passes to the setter at position 2, the setter calls set and sets the hitter, and the hitter calls hit and sends it over.

steps.say: The ball comes over. The passer calls “mine.”
Pass to the setter at position 2, right front. She calls “set.”
The setter sets the hitter, who calls “hit.”
Over the net: pass, set, hit. Three contacts.

w-formation.title: The W formation
w-formation.summary: Five passers form a W across the back two-thirds of the court while the setter waits at the net; the closest passer takes the serve to the setter.

steps.say: Five players in a W across the back two-thirds of the court. The setter waits at the net.
The coach serves.
The closest player calls “mine” and passes to the setter.
Then run pass, set, hit.
Over the net.

three-back.title: Three back, three at the net
three-back.summary: Three back-row players spread across the baseline and three front-row players stand at the net; a back-row player passes the serve up to the front row.

steps.say: Three back-row players spread across the baseline; three front-row players at the net.
The coach serves.
A back-row player calls it and passes up to the front row.
The front row sets it.
And sends it over: pass, set, hit.

free-ball.title: Free ball
free-ball.summary: When the other side sends an easy ball, the coach calls free ball and the team turns it into pass, set, hit.

steps.say: The other side sends an easy ball over.
Coach calls “FREE BALL!” The team goes on offense.
Pass to the setter.
Set the hitter.
Hit it over.
